say:1:1421353001:1.text: So, what do you want with me? Are you going to keep attacking me and my beliefs?
say:1:1421353001:1.source_cn: 所以，你们找我有何贵干？想继续辱骂我曾经的信仰吗？

choice_prompt:2:1421353001.text: So, what do you want with me? Are you going to keep attacking me and my beliefs?
choice_prompt:2:1421353001.source_cn: 所以，你们找我有何贵干？想继续辱骂我曾经的信仰吗？

say:3:1421353002:1.text: Don't tell me it's another boring piece of relic... Whatever, I'll take a look.
say:3:1421353002:1.source_cn: 好啊，又是什么无聊的罪恶的东西？我看就是了。

say:4:1421353004:1.text: You should be able to understand the beginning of the document. Read it for yourself.
say:4:1421353004:1.source_cn: ……你应该也能看懂这份文件的开头，你自己读吧。

say:5:1421353005:1.text:
Alright, hand it here.
"Helthor's... Brimstone Workshop, 8th batch of the 14th production cycle..."
say:5:1421353005:1.source_cn: 读就读。\n赫托及……深岩工坊，某年第8批第14号线锻造……

say:6:1421353006:1.text: "Full echorite manufacturing of the battle longbow—version EP04..." What is this?!
say:6:1421353006:1.source_cn: 全精深岩晶制造主战长弓EP04……这，这写的什么东西？！

say:8:1421353007:1.text: Look at the writing at the bottom.
say:8:1421353007:1.source_cn: 来，看这里，最下面的手写。

say:9:1421353008:1.text: "Version number cannot be shared with external stakeholders. Temporary codename—<style="highlight">Eclipsion</style>?!"
say:9:1421353008:1.source_cn: 版本号起名无法对外，临时赋用代号——<style=hi...

say:11:1421353009:1.text: Inna stares at Zanie in disbelief while Zanie calmly flips to another page of the documents.
say:11:1421353009:1.source_cn: 伊娜难以置信地抬头看向祖娅，而祖娅平静地再次翻开了这份文件。

say:12:1421353010:1.text: You asked what this is... You and Hyla should be very familiar with it.
say:12:1421353010:1.source_cn: 刚刚你问的这写的什么东西……你和海拉主管，都应该很熟悉才是。

say:13:1421353011:1.text: Helthor, our god, was the master designer who made this weapon.
say:13:1421353011:1.source_cn: 赫托，伟大的神明，是这份武器的主设计师和主负责人。

say:14:1421353012:1.text: Brimstone Workshop was his primary production plant. It was also the heart of operations, where Helthor's supervisor managed all production and design.
say:14:1421353012:1.source_cn: 深岩工坊，是它主要出产的工厂和生产线名称，也是赫托主管...

say:15:1421353013:1.text: A specific year isn't mentioned, but the "8th batch of the 14th production cycle" refers to the manufacturing of special creations under that year's production directives.
say:15:1421353013:1.source_cn: 年份就不提了，第8批第14号线，代表本年度批次下的第1...

say:16:1421353014:1.text: "Version EP04" represents the fourth iteration of what was designed and crafted.
say:16:1421353014:1.source_cn: 而EP04，则代表着是迭代后的第四版本。

say:17:1421353015:1.text: During weapon iteration, the most representative version is selected from the best models and then modified for improvement...
say:17:1421353015:1.source_cn: 在迭代武器的时候，会从版本中优中选优选出最有代表性的一...

say:18:1421353016:1.text: So, the Eclipsion was simply a template used to determine the next iteration from numerous batches?
say:18:1421353016:1.source_cn: 所以，杜恩加尔，只是诸多批次版本中择选出下次迭代的模板？

say:19:1421353017:1.text: Exactly. What this naming process proves is that...
say:19:1421353017:1.source_cn: 正是。这个命名方式能够证明的是……

say:20:1421353018:1.text: ...the Ironheart Dominion you're so obsessed with, Inna, was not an ancient land of perfection and tradition.
say:20:1421353018:1.source_cn: 伊娜，你所向往的钢心帝国，并不是充斥着传统与诗歌的古老国度。

say:21:1421353019:1.text: Right before the Dominion fell apart, the generalist engineers were already on their way out. They saw the writing on the wall.
say:21:1421353019:1.source_cn: 甚至在帝国覆灭前夕，无所不精的多面手工程师也在慢慢退出舞台。

say:22:1421353020:1.text: During the age of ancient gods and empires, the dwarves were already exploring the division of labor, specialization, and the creation of standardized production processes.
say:22:1421353020:1.source_cn: 在神明临世，帝国长存的古老年代，矮人们就已经开始尝试分...

say:23:1421353021:1.text: They developed methods to mass-produce these artifacts. Even divine power and magic were controlled through machinery. The dwarves were carving their own path.
say:23:1421353021:1.source_cn: 并且探索着，能够批量生产所谓神器，连神力与魔力都为机械...

say:24:1421353022:1.text: But what's the difference between this and our current manufacturing and production lines?
say:24:1421353022:1.source_cn: 这，这和我们现在的工厂和生产线有什么区别？

say:25:1421353023:1.source_cn: ……没有区别。正是因为没有区别！

say:26:1421353024:1.text: We've actually been walking on the same broken path... No, <style="highlight">this path was never broken</style>. It was always the same.
say:26:1421353024:1.source_cn: 所以，我们其实一直走在曾经一度断绝……不，或许<sty...

say:27:1421353025:1.text: All the gods had betrayed us. Our empire gone... But sin will eventually be washed away by time.
say:27:1421353025:1.source_cn: 神明背叛了我们，帝国覆灭……罪孽终究会被时光冲刷。

say:28:1421353026:1.text: In the face of any harsh environment, we dwarves persevere, driven by an unyielding spirit of innovation—and, yes, a touch of arrogance.
say:28:1421353026:1.source_cn: 但，我们矮人无论身处怎样的环境，始终踏实肯干，不断升级...

say:29:1421353027:1.text: Over the centuries, this path was never broken. It was passed on to us.
say:29:1421353027:1.source_cn: 多年以来，从未断绝，始终被我们传承着。

say:30:1421353028:1.text:
...
But what is the purpose of this spirit of innovation? What does it truly serve?
say:30:1421353028:1.source_cn: ………………\n但，我们要这些所谓的精神有什么用？

say:31:1421353029:1.text: Zanie doesn't answer directly. Instead, she pulls out a weapon she had crafted specifically for the dragon and hands it to Inna.
say:31:1421353029:1.source_cn: 祖娅没有直接回答，只是掏出了一样东西——是之前她特别制...

say:32:1421353030:1.text: Inna gives her a puzzled look but is quickly drawn to the intriguing structure of the weapon. After a moment, she looks up, her curiosity piqued.
say:32:1421353030:1.source_cn: 伊娜疑惑地看了她一眼，但立刻就被这有趣的结构所吸引，过...

say:33:1421353031:1.text: If I'm not mistaken, the lead here utilizes magic infusion, which allows for faster, more precise, and more powerful effects compared to standard mechanical firing.
say:33:1421353031:1.source_cn: 我没看错的话，这里的引线使用了魔力注入，从而能产生比一...

say:34:1421353032:1.text: So, why not add the same structure to this section?
say:34:1421353032:1.source_cn: 但要是这样，为什么不在这一部分再增加同样的结构呢？

say:35:1421353033:1.text: Honestly, when I first designed it, I wasn't sure I'd find a mage who'd be willing to pump magic into it the way I wanted.
say:35:1421353033:1.source_cn: 因为在设计之初，我还不确定能不能找到按照我的标准愿意为...

say:36:1421353034:1.text: Take a closer look, and you'll see that the trigger conditions for the magic are extremely strict. The mage has to be crazy precise with their magic in order for it to work.
say:36:1421353034:1.source_cn: 如果你足够仔细，就会发现，魔力引线的触发条件非常严苛，...

say:37:1421353035:1.text: However, I wasn't wrong, you have a keen sense of touch.
say:37:1421353035:1.source_cn: 但，我果然没有看错，你有着足够敏锐的触觉和大胆的思路。

say:38:1421353036:1.text: So, Inna, want to team up and explore the practical uses of new materials? We can figure out what they're good for together.
say:38:1421353036:1.source_cn: 所以，伊娜，你是否愿意与我一起，共同探索新材料的实用性...

say:39:1421353037:1.text: New materials? But there's no more echorite...

say:42:1421353038:1.text: As if responding to her words, the communicator lights up, and Indris' voice comes through clearly.
say:42:1421353038:1.source_cn: 仿佛回答她的话一般，通讯器亮起，因度厄的声音响了起来。

say:46:1421353039:0.text: I found it, Zanie. It was exactly where you said it was. Deep in the mines, where the dragon's magic is the strongest, there is plenty here.
say:46:1421353039:0.source_cn: 找到了，祖娅。在你说的地方，矿山深处，龙的魔力浸染最深...

say:48:1421353041:1.text: Some are translucent, while others have a shiny, metallic look!
say:48:1421353041:1.source_cn: 有些是半透明的，但有些看起来像是金属矿物一样！

say:52:1421353043:1.text: Wait, isn't that a specialty of Brimstone Village? Indeed, there are mines everywhere, but why is the ore in a different form here?
say:52:1421353043:1.source_cn: 那、那不是我们深岩村的特产吗？地下确实也该有矿区，但这...

say:53:1421353044:1.text: Yes, well, in the days of the Dominion, Helthor's Brimstone Workshop was located right here in our Brimstone Village.
say:53:1421353044:1.source_cn: 是的，那正是在帝国的时代，深岩村所在的地方，被赫托选中...

say:54:1421353045:1.text: I read about this in a few historical records.
say:54:1421353045:1.source_cn: 我曾经在记载中见过只言片语关于它的描述。

say:55:1421353046:1.text: The metal crafted from celestrite is lightweight, flexible, sharp, and as malleable as silk. Plus, you can pump all kinds of magic into it.
say:55:1421353046:1.source_cn: 轻盈，柔韧，锋锐，延展性如丝绸般惊人，能承载各类力量注...

say:56:1421353047:1.text: It's called <style="highlight">azuresteel</style> because of its striking blue color.
say:56:1421353047:1.source_cn: 因为它呈现出美丽的蓝色，而被外界称为<style=hi...

say:57:1421353048:1.text: However, Helthor himself named it <style="highlight">brimstone steel</style>.
say:57:1421353048:1.source_cn: 但，赫托为它亲自命名为——<style=highlig...

say:58:1421353049:1.text: Thus, the name Brimstone Workshop became well-known. While I'm unsure how echorite got its name, brimstone steel was named for the work done at its place of origin.
say:58:1421353049:1.source_cn: 深岩工坊因此得名，多年后的深岩晶，倒不如说是模仿着深岩...

say:59:1421353050:1.text: It was mentioned in the voice message that dragon magic was strong at that location and that the celestrite was there as well.
say:59:1421353050:1.source_cn: ……刚刚通讯里提到，龙的魔力浸染，而天青矿也在矿洞里……

say:60:1421353051:1.text: In other words, brimstone steel cannot form naturally. It may require magic to be infused into it.
say:60:1421353051:1.source_cn: 也就是说，深岩钢不是天然形成的矿物，而是需要注入魔力后...

say:61:1421353052:1.text: Yep, that's what it says. It's not really an update about the Eclipsion—more like a test plan for brimstone steel's specific parts.
say:61:1421353052:1.source_cn: 是的，这份文件里记载着的，与其说是杜恩加尔的迭代版本，...

say:62:1421353053:1.text: All the ore in Brimstone Village is naturally capable of enchantment. All we need is a large amount of magic and then forge in a special way...
say:62:1421353053:1.source_cn: 深岩村的所有矿产，天然更能承载魔力，只需要大量注入魔力...

say:63:1421353054:1.text: Back in the day, there were so many different properties of brimstone steel. The Dominion was an empire dominated by arcane steel.
say:63:1421353054:1.source_cn: 就能形成各种各样不同性质的深岩钢材，也就是一度称霸帝国...

say:64:1421353055:1.text: The existence of azuresteel is proof of their ambition to forge their own brimstone steel.
say:64:1421353055:1.source_cn: 也就是说，蓝魔钢只是他们实现“深岩钢”野心的第一步而已。

say:65:1421353056:1.text: So, the blue ore in the mines ended up like that because of the magic from the underground dragons. It's not wholly natural—it's their influence...
say:65:1421353056:1.source_cn: 所、所以，矿洞里那些蓝矿，应该只是沾上了地下少数龙的魔...

say:66:1421353057:1.text: If someone is willing to infuse it with magic and reforge it, it can take on different properties, right?
say:66:1421353057:1.source_cn: 只要有人愿意注入魔力，再重复锻打，它也能呈现出不同的性质？

choice_prompt:67:1421353057.text: If someone is willing to infuse it with magic and reforge it, it can take on different properties, right?
choice_prompt:67:1421353057.source_cn: 只要有人愿意注入魔力，再重复锻打，它也能呈现出不同的性质？

say:68:1421353058:1.text: I-I'll go get a piece of celestrite right away!
say:68:1421353058:1.source_cn: 我、我去取一块天青矿，稍等！

say:69:1421353059:1.text: Hyla dashes out and comes back moments later, clutching a huge piece of celestrite in her hand.
say:69:1421353059:1.source_cn: 海拉飞快地跑开，很快，就捧着一大块天青矿来到了我们的面前……

choice:2:0:1.text: Zanie has something to show you.
choice:2:0:1.male: Zanie has something to show you.
choice:2:0:1.female: Zanie has something to show you.

say:71:1421353003:1.text: How important? Another cursed document from those dark days?
say:71:1421353003:1.source_cn: 有多重要？不就又是一份罪恶时代的罪恶废纸？
